mixed_qos_draft_oracles.source_text: When Clients make subscriptions with Topic Filters that include wildcards, it is possible for a Client’s subscriptions to overlap so that a published message might match multiple filters. In this case the Server MUST deliver the message to the Client respecting the maximum QoS of all the matching subscriptions [MQTT-3.3.5-1]. In addition, the Server MAY deliver further copies of the message, one for each additional matching subscription and respecting the subscription’s QoS in each case.
captured_wire_checks: SUBACK granted QoS <= requested QoS parsed from raw RX frame per matrix row
Delivered PUBLISH QoS equals min(publish_qos, granted_qos) with matching QoS0/1/2 handshake
allowed_variants: Single independent clean subscriber per row; requested QoS 0/1/2 vs published QoS 0/1/2 (granted <= requested)
Multiple overlapping subscriptions explicitly deferred to overlap diagnostic / profile-specific addendum
mixed_qos_draft_oracles.parameter_rationale: 9-row orthogonal matrix exercises independent granted-QoS negotiation & downgrade rules without conflating Mosquitto 2.0.22 overlap dedup discrepancy (MQTT-T07).
remaining_gaps: Overlapping wildcard dedup excluded from MQTT311-MIXED-QOS-001 (tracked separately in MQTT-T07)
Requires independent semantic approval before normative-map promotion

mixed_qos_draft_oracles.source_text: The SUBACK Packet sent by the Server to the Client MUST contain a return code for each Topic Filter/QoS pair. This return code MUST either show the maximum QoS that was granted for that Subscription or indicate that the subscription failed [MQTT-3.8.4-5]. The Server might grant a lower maximum QoS than the subscriber requested. The QoS of Payload Messages sent in response to a Subscription MUST be the minimum of the QoS of the originally published message and the maximum QoS granted by the Server. The server is permitted to send duplicate copies of a message to a subscriber in the case where the original message was published with QoS 1 and the maximum QoS granted was QoS 0 [MQTT-3.8.4-6].

0x80 failure code transitions row/case to BLOCKED positive precondition rather than silent skip

remaining_gaps: Multi-filter single SUBSCRIBE packet batching deferred beyond 1-filter-per-row matrix
